# Bundled frontend dependencies

- Bootstrap 5.3.3: bootstrap.min.css, obtained from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
- Chart.js 4.4.8: chart.umd.js, obtained from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.8/dist/chart.umd.js

License texts are included beside these files.
